;; gen-rdr.toc - GENERATED by interpreter/intrp-emit.toc (do not edit).

(add-ns rdr (module "intrp-rdr.toc"))

(defp parse-then [r f])
(extend-type rdr/ParserMatch (parse-then [r f] (f (.value r) (.state r))))
(extend-type rdr/ParserIgnore (parse-then [r f] r))
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-then [r f] r))

(defp parse-or [r else-f])
(extend-type rdr/ParserMatch (parse-or [r e] r))
(extend-type rdr/ParserIgnore (parse-or [r e] r))
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-or [r e] (e r)))

(defp parse-error-msg [r])
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-error-msg [v] (.msg v)))

(defp parse-error-state [r])
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-error-state [v] (.state v)))


(defn parse-error-line [file out line msg]
  (exit 1 (to-str [out file ":" (number-str line) ":" msg])))
(def symbol)
(def symbol-start)
(def rest-of-symbol)
(def alpha)
(def digits)
(def integer)
(def double-quoted-string)
(def escaped-char)
(def expression)
(defn symbol-1-char [c] (or (or (and (<= 97 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 122)) (and (<= 65 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 90))) (and (<= 48 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 57)) (str= c ".") (str= c "_") (str= c "<") (str= c ">") (str= c "=") (str= c "+") (str= c "-") (str= c "*") (str= c "?") (str= c "!")))
(defn symbol-1 [state]
  (let [t (rdr/read-run state symbol-1-char)]
    (rdr/ParserMatch (.text t) (.state t))))
(defn symbol [state]
  (parse-then (symbol-start state)
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (parse-then (symbol-1 s1)
                            (fn [v1 s2]
                              (rdr/ParserMatch [v0 v1] s2))))))
(defn symbol-start [state]
  (parse-or (alpha state)
            (fn [e1]
              (cond (or (str-prefix? "." (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "_" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "<" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? ">" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "=" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "+" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "-" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "*" (.input state))
                    (str-prefix? "/" (.input state)))
                    (rdr/ParserMatch (subs (.input state) 0 1)
                                     (rdr/take-char state)
                                     (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))))
(defn rest-of-symbol [state]
  (parse-or (alpha state)
            (fn [e1]
              (parse-or (digits state)
                        (fn [e2]
                          (cond (or (str-prefix? "." (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "_" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "<" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? ">" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "=" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "+" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "-" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "*" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "?" (.input state))
                                (str-prefix? "!" (.input state)))
                                (rdr/ParserMatch (subs (.input state) 0 1)
                                                 (rdr/take-char state)
                                                 (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))))))
(defn alpha-0 [state]
  (let [input (.input state)
        c (subs input 0 1)]
    (cond (str= c "")
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected end of input" state)
      (and (<= 97 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 122))
      (rdr/ParserMatch c (rdr/take-char state))
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn alpha-1 [state]
  (let [input (.input state)
        c (subs input 0 1)]
    (cond (str= c "")
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected end of input" state)
      (and (<= 65 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 90))
      (rdr/ParserMatch c (rdr/take-char state))
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn alpha [state]
  (parse-or (alpha-0 state)
            (fn [e1]
              (alpha-1 state))))
(defn digits [state]
  (let [input (.input state)
        c (subs input 0 1)]
    (cond (str= c "")
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected end of input" state)
      (and (<= 48 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 57))
      (rdr/ParserMatch c (rdr/take-char state))
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn integer-1-char [c] (and (<= 48 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 57)))
(defn integer-1 [state]
  (let [t (rdr/read-run state integer-1-char)]
    (rdr/ParserMatch (.text t) (.state t))))
(defn integer [state]
  (parse-then (digits state)
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (parse-then (integer-1 s1)
                            (fn [v1 s2]
                              (rdr/ParserMatch [v0 v1] s2))))))
(defn double-quoted-string-1-0-0 [state]
  (let [input (.input state)
        c (subs input 0 1)]
    (cond (str= c "")
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected end of input" state)
      (not (str= c "\""))
      (rdr/ParserMatch c (rdr/take-char state))
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn double-quoted-string-1-0 [state]
  (parse-or (double-quoted-string-1-0-0 state)
            (fn [e1]
              (escaped-char state))))
(defn double-quoted-string-1 [state acc]
  (parse-or (parse-then (double-quoted-string-1-0 state)
                        (fn [v s2]
                          (double-quoted-string-1 s2 (vect-conj acc v))))
            (fn [e]
              (rdr/ParserMatch acc state))))
(defn double-quoted-string [state]
  (parse-then (cond (str-prefix? "\"" (.input state))
                    (rdr/ParserMatch "\"" (rdr/take-char state))
                    (rdr/ParserError "expected \"\\\"\"" state))
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (parse-then (double-quoted-string-1 s1 empty-vector)
                            (fn [v1 s2]
                              (parse-then (cond (str-prefix? "\"" (.input s2))
                                                (rdr/ParserMatch "\"" (rdr/take-char s2))
                                                (rdr/ParserError "expected \"\\\"\"" s2))
                                          (fn [v2 s3]
                                            (rdr/ParserMatch [v0 v1 v2] s3))))))))
(defn escaped-char-1 [state]
  (cond (or (str-prefix? "\\" (.input state))
        (str-prefix? "\"" (.input state))
        (str-prefix? "n" (.input state))
        (str-prefix? "r" (.input state))
        (str-prefix? "t" (.input state)))
        (rdr/ParserMatch (subs (.input state) 0 1)
                         (rdr/take-char state)
                         (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn escaped-char [state]
  (parse-then (cond (str-prefix? "\\" (.input state))
                    (rdr/ParserMatch "\\" (rdr/take-char state))
                    (rdr/ParserError "expected \"\\\\\"" state))
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (parse-then (escaped-char-1 s1)
                            (fn [v1 s2]
                              (rdr/ParserMatch [v0 v1] s2))))))
(defn expression-3-2 [state acc]
  (parse-or (parse-then (expression state)
                        (fn [v s2]
                          (expression-3-2 s2 (vect-conj acc v))))
            (fn [e]
              (rdr/ParserMatch acc state))))
(defn expression-3 [state]
  (parse-then (cond (str-prefix? "(" (.input state))
                    (rdr/ParserMatch "(" (rdr/take-char state))
                    (rdr/ParserError "expected \"(\"" state))
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (parse-then (expression s1)
                            (fn [v1 s2]
                              (parse-then (expression-3-2 s2 empty-vector)
                                          (fn [v2 s3]
                                            (parse-then (cond (str-prefix? ")" (.input s3))
                                                              (rdr/ParserMatch ")" (rdr/take-char s3))
                                                              (rdr/ParserError "expected \")\"" s3))
                                                        (fn [v3 s4]
                                                          (rdr/ParserMatch [v0 v1 v2 v3] s4))))))))))
(defn expression [state]
  (parse-or (integer state)
            (fn [e1]
              (parse-or (double-quoted-string state)
                        (fn [e2]
                          (parse-or (symbol state)
                                    (fn [e3]
                                      (expression-3 state))))))))
(defn parse-seq [file state acc]
  (let [s (rdr/skip-whitespace state)]
    (cond (str= (.input s) "")
      (rdr/ParserMatch acc s)
      (parse-or (parse-then (expression s)
                            (fn [v s2]
                              (parse-seq file (rdr/skip-whitespace s2)
                                          (to-str [acc (to-str [v "\n"])]))))
                (fn [e] (parse-error-line file acc
                                          (rdr/state-line (parse-error-state e))
                                          (parse-error-msg e)))))))

(main [argv]
  (let [file (extract (get argv 1))]
    (parse-then (parse-seq file (rdr/make-state (slurp file) file 1) "")
                (fn [out s] (pr* out)))))
